# GitHub Pages + Install Scripts

## Summary

Add a static documentation site and install scripts for `archr`, mirroring the user experience and technical practices from bun.com.

**Status:** ✅ Implemented & verified

## Goals

- Provide a clean, searchable documentation site at `https://haquiticos.github.io/archr`
- Offer multiple installation methods: install script (curl|bash), PowerShell, cargo install, and manual binary download
- Mirror bun.com/installation UX: automatic PATH setup, version pinning, platform detection, and clear upgrade/uninstall docs
- Avoid over-engineering: use mdBook (binário Rust, ~1MB), no JS frameworks, no build steps extra

## What was done

### 1. GitHub Pages site (mdBook)

**Files:**
- `docs/book.toml` — mdBook config with git repo link and cname
- `docs/src/SUMMARY.md` — sidebar and navigation structure
- `docs/src/introduction.md` — landing page
- `docs/src/installation.md` — installation guide (curl|bash, PowerShell, cargo, build from source)
- `docs/src/upgrade.md` — upgrade guide (re-run install script / cargo install)
- `docs/src/uninstall.md` — uninstall guide
- `docs/src/cli/`.md — CLI reference for each subcommand
- `docs/src/guides/yaml.md` — how to define a model in YAML
- `docs/src/guides/archi.md` — import into Archi workflow
- `docs/src/reference/rules.md` — quick summary of ArchiMate rules with link to SPEC.md
- `docs/src/reference/skill.md` — Agent Skill documentation

**Workflow:**
- `.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml` — mdBook build → GitHub Pages deploy (peaceiris/actions-mdbook + actions/deploy-pages)
- Tested: `mdbook build` succeeds locally; artifact contains `index.html`, `installation.html`, etc.

### 2. Install scripts

**Linux & macOS (`install/install.sh`):**
- Detects OS and architecture (uname -s / uname -m)
- Supports target resolution: archr-linux-x86_64, archr-macos-arm64, archr-macos-x86_64
- Downloads from `releases/latest/download/<target>` or pinned tag (`v1.0.0`)
- Installs to `$HOME/.archr/bin/archr` (configurable via `$ARCHR_INSTALL`)
- Adds `$ARCHR_INSTALL/bin` to PATH (bash/zsh/fish) via marker `# archr`
- Writes `export PATH="$ARCHR_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"` to rc files
- Post-install validation with `archr --version`

**Windows (`install/install.ps1`):**
- Detects architecture via `RuntimeInformation.ProcessArchitecture`
- Downloads `archr-windows-x86_64.exe` from releases
- Installs to `$env:USERPROFILE\.archr\bin\archr.exe`
- Appends install dir to user-level PATH
- Supports `-Version "v1.0.0"` pinning

### 3. Documentation for usage

- `installation.md`: complete guide mirroring bun.com/installation (platforms, requirements, PATH, direct downloads, version pinning)
- `upgrade.md`: self-upgrade via re-running install script / cargo install (no self-upgrade subcommand yet)
- `uninstall.md`: remove `$HOME/.archr` and clean up PATH entries
- `cli/overview.md`, `cli/*.md`: each subcommand documented with args, exit codes, JSON result formats
- `guides/yaml.md` and `guides/archi.md`: YAML schema and round-trip workflow

### 4. Git configuration

- Added `docs/book/*` to `.gitignore` (generated by mdBook)
- Install scripts are tracked and ready for use from raw URLs

## Usage examples

### Linux / macOS (curl|bash)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haquiticos/archr/main/install/install.sh | bash
```

Pin a version:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haquiticos/archr/main/install/install.sh | bash -s "v1.0.0"
```

### Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
powershell -c "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haquiticos/archr/main/install/install.ps1 | iex"
```

### Via cargo

```bash
cargo install archr-core
archr --version
```

## Validation

- Smoke test 1: `source install/install.sh` successfully downloaded `archr-linux-x86_64` and validated `archr --version`
- Smoke test 2: `mdbook build docs` produces HTML with `index.html`, `installation.html`, `upgrade.html`, `uninstall.html`, and all CLI/guides pages
- All paths in `SUMMARY.md` resolve to existing markdown files
- Installation docs include exact URLs to scripts (raw.githubusercontent.com) and to GitHub Releases

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Docs site builds with mdBook and deploys to GitHub Pages at `haquiticos.github.io/archr`
- [x] `install.sh` installs the latest binary for the detected platform and sets PATH
- [x] `install.ps1` installs the Windows binary and appends to user PATH
- [x] `installation.md` documents all supported methods and includes PATH fix section
- [x] `upgrade.md` documents upgrade via re-running install script or cargo install
- [x] `uninstall.md` documents removal of install directory and optional PATH cleanup
- [x] CLI docs cover all subcommands with exit codes and JSON result formats
- [x] Guides cover YAML schema and Archi round-trip workflow
- [x] No extra build steps or runtime dependencies beyond mdBook (Rust binário)
